title: Git History: keep old rows up during a re-read (no blink)
body: restart() swaps in a fresh HistoryView, so the timeline blanks ~100 ms until the new stream's first page lands. Silent at-top re-reads (poll_refs) now make this blink on every commit when agents commit often; pill click and Refresh blink too. Keep the retired pages/count painted until the first page arrives, then swap. Watch: scroll offset (new generation id), selection, the retire-off-GUI-thread drop. See src/git_history.rs (restart, poll_refs, poll) and docs/git-history.md 'Live updates' gotcha.
